items.review_text: if you send someone a link to a post now, it will have your profile attached to it, even if it wasn't your post. they get a popup with whatever account you were logged in to prompting them to follow it. instagram made this change without any notification. details of your profile should not be attached when you copy / paste a link to a post that wasn't even yours, especially when you have all options to make your account visible to contacts / searchable by email disabled.

The video calling on this app is hardly worth using. Each time I've used it, the video quality gets super pixilated and grainy anytime the service isn't exactly *perfect*. The calls also take way too much battery power, quickly heat up the phone, and have overheated the phone before. Having video call functionality is great, but when it's so cumbersome and not worth using, what's the point?

Every time I start using Instagram again I remember why I don't. Every single time I'm on reels and scrolling, eventually the videos will only play halfway and then don't play the rest of the video. It's not a connection issue and I've been dealing with this ever since reels came out. I don't want to watch half a video just for it to cut off.

With the latest update, you can no longer be logged in to more than one account. I've seen no improvements with the last few updates other than the layout, which didn't need fixing, and the logo change. The app used to scroll through my feed smoother too, a thing of the past. It used to work well, but now I might just uninstall it since I have to log in every time anyway. Might as well save the space on my phone for an app that works. Galaxy S5 update: it's now even worse.

They push a lot of silly stuff onto you, and the ads are often just slightly off. Like, yes, I'm interested in this, but not in the way the algorithm seems to think. Otherwise, it's nice to share personal photos and animal pics/vids with people I love. Yet, I find myself thinking of chucking the whole app almost daily. Then again, I often think of disappearing into the wilds, so that just might be the way I'm wired. 🤷🏻‍♂️

Good hell, how are you pushing 2 ads for every 1-2 reels?? I click not interested, I've seen too many ads, irrelevant, inappropriate, blah blah blah but they just keep coming. Also, the new algorithm is ridiculous. Same problems, click not interested and get a related reel immediately after. I'm guessing meta doesn't recognize not interested as valid. Keep "improving" the app, it's so close to being trash👍

this app can be very fun! using it for the first time since facebook bought it back in the day and it's ok. it needs more timeline options, i'd like it to keep my place when my screen turns off or i re-open the app (same problem i have with fb), or at least an option not to refresh, necessarily. it is easy to upload stuff. it runs only on an algorithm so you have to scroll to "friends" where it tells you it's caught up with- but i'm not, i just logged on and watched 2. fix? disable ai summary?

The ads for Threads is getting rediculous. It's made to look like instagram content to get you to click on it. I am not interested in threads no matter how many people I follow have it. That's their business not mine. Chill with all the ads not just Threads. I'm getting ads for things that make no sense, it seems like Instagram doesn't have a team of sorts to monitor which ads their putting out. Do ya'll really want to be associated with half of what you advertise?

Every time someone sends me a DM, I get the notification for it, but when I open it the message immediately disappears. Vanish mode is turned off, and I've cleared casche/data several times. Every time it happens, I have to uninstall and reinstall the app in order for the message to reappear. Incredibly frustrating!

App is absolutely awful on the Z Fold 8. Opening reels from friends will result in either a black screen, frozen video, or the video will zoom way out and I'm not able to interact with it at all (liking it, commenting, reposting, etc). This happens regardless of if I use the phone while folded or open. I'm constantly being shilled Instagram Premium which is insulting because nothing about the base app makes me think "wow! I want to spend money on this thing!".

Stop your endless login loops, they don't work! I have been using this app for years. 3 years ago, I created a new account for my business and was using it until 2 weeks ago when all of a sudden it locked me out, and now has me in an endless login loop. My insta account is linked in Meta, I have tried all the options, reported the bug twice, tried selfie login, get friends help, EVERYTHING! Nothing works. Not a single code to my number or email. Nothing!!!

I wish there was a different platform that my friends would look at to post photos on. It's frankly amazing how bad the photo and video editing workflows are; it is significantly easier to edit elsewhere to then finally post. The ads are plentiful, and only really relevant in terms of being vaguely related to your in-person conversations you swore Instagram was closed during. The algorithm was designed to be addictive, not to show your photos to your friends. 1/10 I consider deleting it daily.
